name: Textarea
description: SEED contract for the Phase-1 reader round (docs/35 §3) — MUI has NO standalone Textarea export; this subject is TextField with `multiline` PINNED true (TextField.js → OutlinedInput → InputBase → TextareaAutosize, the exact composition recipe/fixtures/library-textareas.ts cites). The `content` axis is the recipe's empty|value column expanded by the config through $props into the controlled `value` string (empty '' vs the shared recipe sample), so rest-empty (label overlaying, placeholder hidden by MUI's own rest-empty rule) and value (label shrunk) are BOTH captured; focus rides the standard focus-visible interaction sweep. Subject: @mui/material@9.2.0 (pinned, examples/mui/PROVENANCE.md).
